## Speaker names for guests and external attendees

**Fixed**
- Transcript .txt/.vtt downloads lost speaker names for everyone when a guest or someone from another organisation was in the meeting (most noticeably when they spoke first). Teams leaves the display name off those people's lines; the exporter now recognises the transcript anyway.
- Missing names are filled in from the same speaker's ID: another line where Teams named them, the meeting's join list, or the name shown in the Transcript tab. Names are never guessed, and raw ID codes are never printed as names.
- Same fix applies to "Download all meeting transcripts".

**Tip:** open the Transcript tab and scroll through it once before exporting. If any lines are still unnamed, the browser console (F12) shows a line starting "Transcript entries without a speaker name" with field names only (no transcript text). Please send it along.

## Install
Download the zip below and unzip it. In `chrome://extensions`, remove the old version, turn on **Developer mode**, then choose **Load unpacked** on the unzipped folder.
